items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: Well, I was playing with Kid Rene band, and I was playing with Jack Carey band

ctx.x: Now that was late then, wasn't it? That would have been later. That would have been after. That would have been after, say, in the mid-20s or something.

No, that wasn't that, uh, it wasn't quite the mid-20s. It was, uh, well, right after we left for our bodies. Yeah, around, oh, I think around, uh, I don't know, I just can't remember. Just, uh, the day so long, you know what I mean? The year. Mm-hmm. But I know Buddy stayed over there quite a while. And after we left them over there, that's when we came back here. And that's where we left for, you know, or this boy just sent for a hall to come up there. Well, after that time, my Buddy band was kind of going to…
Well, now, isn't it, isn't it the fact that George replaced, um, Edmund Hall when Edmund Hall left?

items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: But Rene, he was a high man. Yeah, he played high notes.

ctx.x: How did Buddy compare say with Kid Rene? I mean were there styles anything the same or different?

No, there was a different style. Different style altogether. Well both of them boys was tough. They were two good men. But Rene, he was a high man. Yeah, he played high notes. And Rene played something like this boy, Yvonne Thomas. You ever heard of Yvonne Thomas?
Well I've heard about him. Bunk used to talk about him.
